column1: # Raku construct ladder -- rung/construct/form declarations.
# Row raku-ladder-every-feature-in-isolation-with-variations (ceo mint 2026-09-04, on Lon's order:
#   "Make tasks to ensure a complete test ladder covering every feature in isolation with variations and
#    then combinations of features.")
# SCHEMA is hq_T's shared eight-column one (row ladder-forms-column-and-forms-check-every-declared-form-and-
# pair-has-a-witness): RUNG CONSTRUCT REFERENCE FORMS PAIRS WITNESS_ORIGIN STATUS NOTE. FORMS is |-separated,
# one entry per form the reference lists; PAIRS is |-separated lower-rung CONSTRUCT slugs this construct must
# be combined with in the combinations phase (sibling row raku-ladder-feature-combinations-after-isolation,
# opens once this row's rungs are green -- not started here).
# Expected origins: isolation ladder__<rung>_<construct-ish>_<form> · combinations ladder__<rung>_<construct-ish>_with_<lower>.
# REFERENCE cites roast (the official Raku spec-test suite, vendored at /home/resources/roast-master) by its
# Synopsis-numbered directory/file, per the task's "roast S-numbers" instruction -- NOT what SCRIP happens to
# implement, so a census that only named the implementation could never show a gap. Oracle is Rakudo 2026.05
# (rakudo_bin() in lib_oracle_flags.sh, prefers /home/resources/rakudo-local/bin/raku).
# RUNGS 00-09 were built pre-census (row raku-construct-ladder-from-rung-0, seat11 2026-09-03: one coarse
# witness per rung, verified against Rakudo). This file is their FIRST declared census (task step 1), written
# by re-reading each witness's actual source rather than assumed from its name. rung00 was walked further
# this session (3 new per-form witnesses minted, oracle-cut, each proven to FAIL once against a deliberately
# corrupted .ref before being restored -- see this row's LEDGER) and is the first rung fully BUILT under the
# amended schema. Rungs 01-09 are PARTIAL, same shape as the prolog census this schema was proven on: the
# pre-existing witness bundles several forms into one origin (named to satisfy exactly the ONE form matching
# its own suffix, matching that census's own "hello" convention) and the remaining forms the reference lists
# are declared, not yet witnessed -- naming the gap honestly is this file's job, not hiding it.
# STATUS: BUILT = every declared form witnessed · PARTIAL = some · DECLARED = none · RED = witnessed and failing.
# Combinations phase (PAIRS) is out of scope for this row -- left blank throughout; the sibling row fills it.
